user.title: RF Network
user.description:
Control fixed-code RF devices (ceiling fans, shades, plug-in remotes) through one or more ESPHome RF gateways. Gateways are found automatically: each ESPHome node that exposes the `transmit_rf_fan` action is a gateway.

In the ESPHome integration, turn on **Allow the device to perform Home Assistant actions** for every gateway, or received codes will not reach Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: RF Network is already set up. Add devices from its Configure button.

menu_options.add_fan: Add a ceiling fan (12-bit DIP, Bond template A3)
menu_options.add_buttons: Add a remote from learned codes

add_fan.title: Add a ceiling fan
add_fan.description: Enter the fan's 6-bit address: the first 6 digits of any code from its remote (see the RF Network Last code sensor). Every button code is generated from it.

data_description.gateway: Automatic sends through the gateway that most recently heard this fan's remote.

add_buttons.title: Add a remote from learned codes

data.burst_gap_ms: Silence that ends a remote press
data.echo_window_ms: Ignore echoes of our own commands for

data_description.repeat_count: How many times each code is sent. Too few and the fan may miss it; too many and a light toggle can turn into dimming.
data_description.burst_gap_ms: Frames of the same code closer together than this count as one press.
data_description.echo_window_ms: After sending, other gateways hear our own signal. Codes we just sent are ignored for this long.

error.invalid_address: The address must be exactly 6 digits of 0 and 1.
error.address_in_use: Another fan already uses this address. Two fans with the same address always react together; change the DIP switches on one of them.
error.name_in_use: Enter a name that is not already used by another device.
error.invalid_buttons: Some lines could not be read.
